what: M0 1.2 composite in code on the reserve render m0-v8b-r2 (briefs/render-m0-composite-and-cleanup-2026-11-04.md task 1): the sofa group and the coffee-table group put on the round-5b clay; the shell, window, armchair, pendant and sconces untouched

sofa.how: matte: textured fabric (local high-pass energy > 1.6) per column from its first row to the base line, the throw outside the right arm row by row (fabric run, median 31 rows), the legs; the parts behind the old table / decor completed row-wise along the base's slope (+ the base's texture) so what the smaller table uncovers is sofa

table.how: top (convex hull of the oak above its near edge), legs (oak S >= 31 below it), runner (polygon): x and y fitted separately (ends + far edge + near-left foot); the render's table is 1.14x the clay in height and 1.07x in width, so its height comes to the card's h38
table.decor_how: candle holders and bowl uniform (the table's x scale) about their foot, which goes where the table maps it

decor_clean.how: the bowl (its convex hull) and the holders with their soft shadow (dilated 20 px), on the table top: low frequency row by row between the clean oak left and right (>= 26 px from the decor, oak hue / saturation, not the runner; blurred along the rows only) + the grain (high-pass) of the oak further left on the same rows; the placed decor gets a contact shadow (0.72, 7 px)

fills.wall: membrane (harmonic) fill of the low-pass, coarse-to-fine 1/16 -> 1/4, exact at the boundary + 6 px seam correction, + the wall's mirrored high-pass texture (1750, 611, 1900, 763)
fills.skirting: the skirting's own profile at t between its top line and the floor line, left (1190-1236) and right (2606-2660) blended in x
fills.floor: rows in the frame sheared by the floor line's slope (0.0) + floor texture (1700, 1221, 1950, 1278)
fills.rug: rows in the frame sheared by the rug edge's slope (0.0) + rug texture (1500, 1371, 1700, 1503)

shadows.wall: the wall 70 px above / 40 px beside the old sofa: ratio (low-pass known / low-pass clean fill), de-shadowed in place, re-applied moved with the sofa
shadows.under_base: the band under the base: a ratio profile in t (base -> feet, to t 1.6) from the visible columns right of the table, re-drawn under the new base / feet lines (50 columns)
shadows.table: none carried: the rug under the table reads 1.00-1.05 against the fill (no cast shadow to move); a contact shadow (depth 0.78, 5 px) at the near-left leg's new foot
